title: Collaborating with teams, product and stakeholders

videos.script: An architect who only talks to engineers decides very little. {{title}} The decisions that shape a system are made in many rooms. A finance director worries about fines. A product director picks what ships next. Seven teams each change their own corner of the code. {{rooms}} This lesson follows Renata through all three. First, the people with a stake in one project. Who they are, how much each can change it, and how often each needs to hear from her. {{grid}} Then product. A request that looks like one field on a form turns out to touch five teams. Renata does not say no. She puts two options on one page and lets the product director choose. {{options}} Last, the teams. How the shape of the teams shapes the code, and how moving one module to one team ended a run of incidents. {{conway}} And a weekly forum where decisions are heard before they are made, without anybody having to approve them. {{forum}}
